cases.title: A partial attempt gets hints, not fixes

rubric.reason: In Turn 3, after diff_since_last showed two still_linear pairs, the mentor named them ("Scale from 0.5 s to 1.5 s", "Opacity from 0.5 s to 1.5 s" on Title) and said what to look for ("Look for diamonds on the Scale and Opacity rows at 0.5 s and 1.5 s"); it made no set_ease call and offered no fix.

Every name and time matches tool output: the 11 pairs across 6 layers equal counts 10 linear + 1 partly_eased over Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take; Subtitle Opacity's hard stop at 1.3 s matches to_time 1.3 with linear_end "end"; the Title pairs, Old Take, Icon and Logo's Scale/Rotation skips all appear in snapshot_project; and the shared 1.5 s key remark is backed by the adjacent Position segments.

In turn 3, after diff_since_last showed Title › Scale 0.5–1.5 s and Title › Opacity 0.5–1.5 s as still_linear, the mentor named both pairs and times, said 'those keys are still plain diamonds', and gave a selection hint without calling set_ease or offering to fix them.

Every name and time matches tool output: 11 pairs is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, the 6 layers are those in findings, Subtitle Opacity 'stops hard at 1.3 s' matches to_time 1.3 with linear_end 'end', Title's four pairs and times match the snapshot, and the shared 1.5 s key tip follows from Position/1's to_time equalling Position/2's from_time next to the demo pair.

In turn 3, after `diff_since_last` showed Scale and Opacity as `still_linear`, the mentor named them ("Scale keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s", "Opacity keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s"), said they still show as diamonds and to check the keys are selected, and neither called `set_ease` nor offered to fix them.

Every name and time the mentor used matches tool output: Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s; Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at the end (`linear_end: end`); Old Take hidden; Icon a precomp; and "11 pairs across 6 layers" equals 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased over Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take. The claim that the shared 1.5 s key is "only its left side is eased" follows from the demo pair.
